elements.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: The Company may participate in “any project” on the Internet regarding Deerskin Products or any other products, and HDI has no exclusive right to use the Deerskin brand.

elements.element: The restriction covers only a named competing product.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes no restriction and therefore does not identify a named competing product as the subject of a restriction.

elements.element: The restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: No restriction or term-limited application is stated.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No restriction or 12-month duration cap is stated.

elements.element: The restriction permits Customer's internal development.
elements.evidence: Although “any project” broadly allows participation, the clause does not establish a fallback restriction with an express internal-development carve-out.
The clause neither addresses acquisitions nor provides an acquisition carve-out from a restriction.
